breaking_news.headline: Why American investors love European defense startups
breaking_news.summary: As European defense spending takes off, just about half of the funding in Europe's defense tech industry is coming from American investors this year. One reason why: European investment firms have restrictions on how they can invest.

breaking_news.headline: How the oil industry is preparing for Hurricane Isaias
breaking_news.summary: Hurricane Isaias is this season's first Atlantic hurricane, and is on a path to hit the northern Gulf Coast. How is the oil industry preparing?

breaking_news.headline: Despite the controversy, data centers could be attractive to struggling rural towns
breaking_news.summary: There's lots of debate over data centers and where they should be located. In a struggling rural town data center development can look a lot more attractive.

breaking_news.headline: How the beverage aisle got so wild
breaking_news.summary: Planet Money traced many new beverage flavors to one laboratory that serves dozens of companies to see how new flavors are created and why we're seeing such an explosion of options right now.

breaking_news.headline: Fired OpenAI employees question the company's commitment to safety
breaking_news.summary: The three fired workers say OpenAI punished them for being outspoken about safety. The company disputes the claims and says they were fired over mishandling sensitive information.

breaking_news.headline: Kalshi taps former FBI agent to fight against money laundering
breaking_news.summary: The prediction market company says it wants to prevent its platform from being abused by criminals. The company is facing mounting pressure over market manipulation and insider trading on the site.

breaking_news.headline: It's taking longer to find a new job after losing one
breaking_news.summary: People who lose their jobs in this economy are taking longer to find new work. Nearly four in ten people exhaust their unemployment benefits before they land a new job.

breaking_news.headline: Justice Department investigates TV networks, citing possible anti-trust violations
breaking_news.summary: The move escalates Trump's fight with the press amid court battle over barring CNN, Politico and MS NOW from the White House.

breaking_news.headline: Poland stabbings driven by online glorification of violence, Tusk says
breaking_news.summary: The PM was speaking after violent attacks at Polish schools this week left one dead and others injured.

breaking_news.headline: Orangutans released back into Borneo forest after devastating fires
breaking_news.summary: Rescuers moved the apes after their habitats were threatened by intense wildfires over the summer.

breaking_news.headline: Ukraine strikes Yandex data centre in third attack on Russian tech giant
breaking_news.summary: It is the third time this week that Ukraine has targeted Russian tech giant Yandex, forcing the company to suspend its operations.

breaking_news.headline: Homes and bridges swept away as fresh floods hit Nepal
breaking_news.summary: Nepal is still trying to recover from catastrophic floods that hit less than two months ago, leaving thousands dead and missing.

breaking_news.headline: Dozens of gold prospectors killed in strikes on Egypt-Sudan border, rights group says
breaking_news.summary: Neither Egypt nor Sudan has commented on the alleged strikes on an artisanal mining camp on Saturday.

breaking_news.headline: Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk
breaking_news.summary: Police received credible information about possible attacks against Donald Tusk and his defence minister.

breaking_news.headline: One killed, 11 injured in second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days
breaking_news.summary: The Saudi capital has been hit by multiple attacks from the Iran-backed Yemeni group over the weekend.

breaking_news.headline: Trump's 'energy ceasefire' claim welcomed by Zelensky but Russia silent
breaking_news.summary: Ukraine's leader says he will support such a truce if Moscow does, after initially expressing surprise at Donald Trump's announcement.

breaking_news.headline: Analysis: Trump's shock Russia deal highlights mounting pressure to curb fuel prices
breaking_news.summary: The US president hopes to ease his party's pain before next month's midterm elections, writes the BBC's North America correspondent.

breaking_news.headline: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky calls it a gift to Putin
breaking_news.summary: Ukraine's president sharply criticised the move, calling it an "investment in war that must be ended, not prolonged".

breaking_news.headline: Citroen revives the 2CV for an electric age
breaking_news.summary: The French firm is reinventing the classic model as carmakers come under pressure from Chinese rivals.

breaking_news.headline: AI is less regulated than milk, says Microsoft president
breaking_news.summary: Brad Smith calls for global rules on AI, and says the UK is in the "best position" to lead the charge.
